mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently indicates weak labor market conditions, which reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a severe economic contraction, which depresses corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In the early recovery phase following a recession, a housing starts level above 1400 thousand units signals strengthening consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400 during a post-recession recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 305 (index) signals accelerating inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 305.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 3 months and HOUST rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST rise > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of total employment (PAYEMS) below 155,000 thousand persons indicates a contracting labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 155000.
